## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Waveform** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Batched audio waveform tensor |
| **Labels** | Labels | No | 1 | Optional batched class labels |

## Settings

The node has no settings.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: AudioInput is a training audio dataset contract node; PipelineExecutor audio tensor loading is not implemented |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
